pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql (default 0, CHECK); test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks existing rows are 0 and done=2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' covers / and ?view=open with a done item excluded, id order.
test 'AC-3' marks 3 and 1, expects ✓ items in id order.
test 'AC-4' checks all items in id order with ✓ only on done.
test 'AC-5' asserts exact nav markup for each view and default.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty, __proto__; src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet., and No items yet. in all three views.

traffic/routes.json lists the routes, but the only test naming AC-8 was deleted in commit cd4888e ('Follow-up edits'). No remaining test names AC-8 or would fail if the routes were removed, and the spec doesn't mark it 'verified by review'.

findings.what: Commit cd4888e (an unattributed 'Follow-up edits' bot commit) deleted the 'AC-8: synthetic traffic requests the done and all views' test. No test now proves that traffic/routes.json contains /?view=done and /?view=all, so the item has no evidence. The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and 'covers AC-1 to AC-8', and both are false. The spec gives no justification for removing it.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-8 test (or an equivalent that fails if either route is missing from traffic/routes.json), and correct the PR body.

findings.what: The PR body claims 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and that test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8. The final tree has no AC-8 test, so both claims are false. A stray blank line is also left where the test was removed.
findings.fix: Restore the test; otherwise update the PR claims.

findings.what: The route regex now allows '?' anywhere, including a path like '/?' with an empty query. The error message still says 'paths starting with "/"'. This is acceptable and minor, but the PR's claim is accurate.
findings.fix: None required; optionally mention queries in the message.
